name: AODocs
description_en: AODocs manages controlled documents: their ownership, metadata, approval state and versions. It adds governance around files rather than acting as the authoring or scheduling tool for every business process. Its current platform also offers document analysis and AIDA, an AI assistant over controlled content. Deployment choices vary, so the application, file store and AI provider need separate evaluation.
description_zh: AODocs 管理受控文档的负责人、元数据、审批状态与版本，在文件周围增加治理层，而不是承担所有业务流程的编写或排期。当前平台还提供文档分析及面向受控内容的 AI 助手 AIDA。部署方式不同，应用、文件存储与 AI 提供方需分别评估。

core_features.explanation_en: Ownership, approval state and history provide context for the version in force.
core_features.explanation_zh: 以负责人、审批状态及历史确定生效版本的背景。

core_features.explanation_en: Check-out isolates edits from the main version; check-in promotes the draft.
core_features.explanation_zh: 签出将修改与主版本隔离，签入将草稿转为主版本。

core_features.explanation_en: Restore within configured retention; a missing original folder requires another destination.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在配置的保留期内恢复；原文件夹已不存在时需另选目标位置。

en: Evaluate a controlled maintenance-procedure revision with separate reader, editor and approver roles.
zh: 用独立读者、编辑者和审批者角色评估维护规程的受控修订。
use_cases.basis: Synthetic proposed evaluation; no customer adoption or measured result.

Deployment.en: Managed service arrangements vary by application and file-storage placement.
Deployment.zh: 托管服务方案因应用及文件存储位置而异。

steps.en: Define one document class, its effective version and the roles allowed to revise or consume it.
steps.zh: 定义一种文档类、生效版本及允许修订或使用的角色。

steps.en: Review a synthetic revision, attachment reference and trash recovery before expanding the library.
steps.zh: 扩大文库前检查虚构修订、附件引用与回收站恢复。

integrations.scope: Storage and model arrangements read; connector configuration, API permissions and quotas not tested.

items.en: Google attachment revision identity and downstream links require care after restore.
items.zh: 恢复后需注意 Google 附件修订身份及下游链接。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Quote required; no numeric public rate verified.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 需询价；未核实公开数值费率。

Read_at is retrieval time; public-reader text may be cached and does not establish vendor update time.
Draft documentation research only. Independent review, hands-on testing, owner verification and publishing approval remain separate.

sections.title_en: Start with the document decision and its owner
sections.title_zh: 先明确文档决策及负责人
sections.en:
AODocs is useful to evaluate when a team must distinguish a working copy from the document authorized for use. The control page describes owners, lifecycle status, approval history, metadata, search and controlled external participation. These are management functions around files, rather than evidence that AODocs replaces BIM authoring, project scheduling or cost control.

For an editorial pilot, choose a maintenance procedure with an owner, equipment identifier, current approved edition and proposed revision. Decide who may revise it, approve it and read the effective edition. Then verify that the consumer sees the intended version and that an external reviewer cannot broaden access. Treat claimed compliance, ingestion scale and financial outcomes as vendor claims; this research did not validate a regulated process or measure capacity.
sections.zh:
当团队必须区分工作副本与获准使用的文档时，可以评估 AODocs。文档控制页描述负责人、生命周期状态、审批历史、元数据、检索及受控外部参与。这些是围绕文件的管理功能，不证明 AODocs 替代 BIM 编写、项目排期或成本控制。

编辑建议的试点可选一份维护规程，明确负责人、设备标识、当前批准版及提议修订。先确定谁可修订、批准、阅读生效版，再验证使用者看到预期版本、外部审阅者不能扩大访问。合规、导入规模及财务收益属于厂商主张；本研究未验证受监管流程或测量容量。

sections.title_en: A private draft does not change the main document permissions
sections.title_zh: 私有草稿不会改变主文档权限
sections.en:
Check-out creates a draft while other readers continue to see the main document. By default, the draft is available to its creator and library administrators. Sharing the draft does not change the main version’s permissions; class settings can prevent contributors from sharing even their own draft. Views can show different properties and workflow states according to draft access, and administrators may hide the Versions tab.

In the proposed procedure revision, explicitly test the reader, draft editor and approver roles. A person seeing the old state may be correctly viewing the main document, rather than a failed update. The checkout mechanism also matters: a manually created draft must be checked in manually, while workflow checkout must be completed by a workflow transition. No role or approval operation was executed here.
sections.zh:
签出创建草稿，其他读者继续看到主文档。默认只有草稿创建者和文库管理员可访问草稿。共享草稿不会改变主版本权限；文档类设置还可禁止贡献者共享自己创建的草稿。视图可根据草稿访问权显示不同属性及工作流状态，管理员也可隐藏版本选项卡。

在建议的规程修订试点中，应分别检查读者、草稿编辑者和审批者。有人看到旧状态，可能是正确显示主文档，并非更新失败。签出方式也影响完成方式：手动创建的草稿必须手动签入，工作流签出的草稿则必须通过工作流转换完成。本研究未执行角色或审批操作。

sections.title_en: Check in, discard or resolve the draft before deletion
sections.title_zh: 先签入、放弃或处理草稿，再删除文档
sections.en:
Only a user with draft edit rights can check it in or cancel checkout. Check-in makes the draft the new main version and keeps the former main version in the version list. The new version name must not duplicate an existing one. Cancelling checkout discards draft changes instead. A checked-out document cannot be deleted until checkout is completed or cancelled.

For the maintenance example, review the selected draft and approval evidence before promotion. If the proposed change is rejected, distinguish continued editing from deliberately discarding it. A missing Check in action should prompt a permissions and checkout-origin check; it is not a reason to delete and recreate the live document. These are suggested checks, not a tested recovery procedure.
sections.zh:
只有拥有草稿编辑权的用户才可签入或取消签出。签入使草稿成为新主版本，并在版本列表保留原主版本；新版本名称不能与已有名称重复。取消签出则丢弃草稿修改。已签出的文档必须先完成或取消签出才能删除。

在维护规程示例中，提升版本前应检查目标草稿及审批证据。修改遭拒时，要区分继续编辑和明确放弃。缺少签入操作时，应先检查权限及签出来源，而不是删除并重建在线文档。这些是建议检查，未执行恢复测试。

sections.title_en: Use AODocs links when Google attachment identity can change
sections.title_zh: Google 附件身份可能改变时使用 AODocs 链接
sections.en:
The version-control guide distinguishes Google documents from uploaded non-Google files. For Google files, checking in loses revision history from before checkout and changes the original attachment’s Drive link. Restoring a previous version also loses revision history and changes the attachment link. The AODocs document URL stays stable. Non-Google document links behave differently and remain unchanged in the documented operations.

For an external register pointing to the maintenance procedure, prefer the AODocs URL, as the guide recommends, and evaluate downstream references after a revision or restore. Uploading a non-Google replacement while overwriting the current version does not create a new AODocs version; the old attachment is no longer available through that interface. Keeping the current version does create a new AODocs version. Do not equate application version history with a complete, independently restorable backup.
sections.zh:
版本控制指南区分 Google 文档与上传的非 Google 文件。Google 文件签入时，会丢失签出前的修订历史，并改变原附件的 Drive 链接；恢复旧版也会丢失修订历史并改变附件链接。AODocs 文档 URL 保持稳定。非 Google 文档的链接行为不同，在文档所述操作中保持不变。

若外部台账引用维护规程，应按指南建议优先使用 AODocs URL，并在修订或恢复后检查下游引用。上传非 Google 替换文件时，若覆盖当前版本，不会创建新 AODocs 版本，旧附件也不能再从该界面取得；选择保留当前版本则会创建新 AODocs 版本。应用版本历史不等于完整且可独立恢复的备份。

sections.title_en: Trash retention is a recovery window with a storage boundary
sections.title_zh: 回收站保留期是有存储边界的恢复窗口
sections.en:
Only library administrators can access the library trash. Restoration returns an item to its original location when the folder structure survives; otherwise an administrator chooses a target folder or the library root. Restore and permanent-delete actions are logged. The documented default retention is 30 days, configurable by an administrator; minus one disables automatic deletion. Removal occurs within 24 hours after expiry.

The help pages distinguish removal from AODocs from attachment ownership in its storage account. They do not establish that pressing permanent delete securely erases every storage copy, nor a universal cloud recovery promise. For the pilot, inspect the actual library retention and select a synthetic document with a known restore destination. Confirm what happens to metadata, permissions, attachments and references before treating the result as an exit or backup procedure.
sections.zh:
只有文库管理员能访问文库回收站。原文件夹结构仍存在时，项目恢复至原位置；否则管理员选择目标文件夹或文库根目录。恢复及永久删除操作会记录日志。文档所述默认保留期为 30 天，可由管理员配置；设为负一可关闭自动删除。到期后 24 小时内从 AODocs 移除。

帮助页区分从 AODocs 移除与附件仍由存储账户拥有。这不确立点击永久删除会安全擦除所有存储副本，也不是适用于所有云的恢复承诺。建议试点先检查实际文库保留配置，再选择已知恢复目标的虚构文档，检查元数据、权限、附件和引用结果后，才判断能否作为退出或备份流程。

sections.title_en: Customer storage and private cloud are still managed offerings
sections.title_zh: 客户存储与私有云仍属于托管方案
sections.en:
The deployment page offers a fully managed multi-tenant or dedicated SaaS arrangement, SaaS connected to customer-controlled storage and AI providers, and fully managed private-cloud deployment. The advertised customer-storage choices include Google Cloud Storage, Amazon S3, Azure, SharePoint and S3-compatible systems. These choices concern where the components operate and who controls their storage; they do not establish a downloadable, self-maintained open-source edition.

For the proposed procedure library, map file content, metadata, audit records and model requests separately. Ask which arrangement actually applies, which regions and providers are contracted, who operates it and what an export contains. Keeping files in a customer bucket alone does not prove that every record or model request stays there. No private deployment, storage connection, export or independent restore was tested.
sections.zh:
部署页提供完全托管的多租户或专属 SaaS、连接客户控制的存储及 AI 提供方的 SaaS，以及完全托管的私有云部署。宣传的客户存储选择包括 Google Cloud Storage、Amazon S3、Azure、SharePoint 及兼容 S3 的系统。这些选择涉及组件运行地点与存储控制方，不确立存在可下载、自行维护的开源版。

对建议的规程文库，应分别梳理文件正文、元数据、审计记录和模型请求，确认实际方案、约定地区及提供方、运营责任和导出内容。文件位于客户存储桶，不证明每类记录或模型请求都留在该处。本研究未测试私有部署、存储连接、导出或独立恢复。

sections.title_en: AIDA adds a model-processing decision to document control
sections.title_zh: AIDA 给文档控制增加模型处理决策
sections.en:
The GenAI supplement describes AIDA answering from a question, relevant document extracts and the user’s access rights, and analysis that populates structured metadata. Enabling AIDA embeds the library’s documents and attachments using Altirnao-hosted models. Answer generation can involve separately governed AI providers. The supplement explicitly warns that outputs may be inaccurate and require independent confirmation.

For the maintenance example, compare an answer with the effective procedure and its permissions before using it operationally. A controlled repository does not by itself eliminate incorrect answers. Establish the chosen provider, processing terms and permitted data before activation; do not infer a universal no-training or no-external-processing commitment. The public supplement displays inconsistent update dates, so its applicable version needs contract confirmation. This research did not enable AI or submit documents.
sections.zh:
GenAI 补充条款描述 AIDA 根据问题、相关文档摘录及用户访问权回答，并通过分析填写结构化元数据。启用 AIDA 会使用 Altirnao 托管模型对文库文档及附件生成嵌入；回答生成还可能涉及受单独条款约束的 AI 提供方。补充条款明确提醒输出可能不准确，需独立确认。

在维护规程示例中，实际使用回答前应对照生效规程及其权限。资料库受控本身不能消除回答错误。启用前需明确选定提供方、处理条款及允许数据，不能推断为统一的不训练或不向外部处理承诺。公开补充条款显示不同更新时间，适用版本需与合同确认。本研究未启用 AI 或提交文档。

sections.title_en: Quote the licensed scope and term before calculating cost
sections.title_zh: 计算费用前确认许可范围与期限
sections.en:
Public terms describe an order-based proprietary service license for internal business use. Actual amounts were not established. Modules, storage and external services can affect cost. Annual subscriptions renew unless written termination notice arrives at least 30 days before term end; recurring payment does not confer early termination. Cancellation generally carries no refund under the stated provision.

A trial or proof of concept ends at its registered deadline or the start of a purchased subscription; trial content and customizations may be lost afterward. No universal trial duration or continuing free tier was verified. Obtain the applicable order, exit arrangement and total storage/AI/implementation charges before deciding. No quote was requested and no account was created.
sections.zh:
公开条款描述按订单授予、用于内部业务的专有服务许可，未确立实际金额。模块、存储与外部服务可能影响费用。年度订阅会续期，除非在到期前至少 30 天送达书面终止通知；周期性付款不赋予提前终止权。条款所述一般取消情形不退款。

试用或概念验证在登记期限届满或付费订阅开始时结束，之后试用内容和定制可能丢失。未核实统一试用时长或持续免费层。决定前需取得适用订单、退出安排，以及存储、AI 和实施总费用。本研究未询价或创建账户。

seo.title_en: AODocs: Controlled Revisions, Attachment Links and Recovery Conditions
seo.title_zh: AODocs：受控修订、附件链接与恢复条件
seo.description_en: Evaluate document governance through draft permissions, check-in, Google attachment identity, trash retention, managed deployment and AIDA.
seo.description_zh: 通过草稿权限、签入、Google 附件身份、回收站保留、托管部署及 AIDA 评估文档治理。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate AODocs for controlled document revisions.
secondary_questions: Does restoring a version preserve the Drive attachment link?
Who can restore a deleted library document?
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no measured search demand or ranking.

research_gaps.en: No tenant, role change, check-in/out, document, restore, deletion, API, AI, quote, trial, purchase or deployment operation executed.
research_gaps.zh: 未执行租户、角色修改、签入签出、文档、恢复、删除、API、AI、询价、试用、购买或部署操作。

research_gaps.en: Exact order rates, license reassignment, trial length, quotas, retention-module rules, export/exit fidelity, all cloud variants and provider-specific processing remain unverified. Drive-oriented help behavior is not generalized to every Multi-Cloud backend.
research_gaps.zh: 精确订单价格、许可重分配、试用时长、配额、保留模块规则、导出退出保真、全部云方案及提供方专属处理未核实。面向 Drive 的帮助行为不泛化至所有 Multi-Cloud 后端。

research_gaps.en: Compliance, performance and accuracy claims not independently verified. GenAI page update labels conflict; applicable version and provider arrangement need confirmation.
research_gaps.zh: 未独立核查合规、性能与准确性主张。GenAI 页更新时间标签冲突，需确认适用版本及提供方安排。
